title: openlake-project/openlake
claim: openlake-project/openlake — OpenLake is a high performance storage engine for efficient LLM inference and GPU Training
why_good: A high-performance storage engine purpose-built for LLM inference and GPU training (2,290 stars, 422 forks) — real infra pain as model I/O bottlenecks GPUs.
value: Sell to AI-infra teams and clouds as a managed/enterprise storage layer; usage + support, a budget line GPU shops already have.
risk: Heavy infra competing with cloud-native storage and vLLM ecosystems; adoption needs benchmarks and trust at scale.

zh.claim: openlake-project/openlake —— 面向高效 LLM 推理与 GPU 训练的高性能存储引擎。
zh.why_good: 专为 LLM 推理和 GPU 训练打造的高性能存储引擎(2290★、422 fork)——模型 I/O 卡住 GPU,是真实的基础设施痛点。
zh.value: 卖给 AI 基础设施团队和云厂做托管/企业存储层;按量 + 支持,GPU 团队本就有这笔预算。
zh.risk: 重基础设施,要和云原生存储、vLLM 生态竞争;规模化采用需要跑分和信任。
